verdict.rationale: RUN documents paying employees who work in more than one state or local jurisdiction in the same pay period, with ADP handling the tax filing [adp-run-docs-19]. It also documents calculating, filing and paying payroll taxes [adp-run-docs-1] and managing state unemployment insurance accounts [adp-run-docs-21]. Missing for 10: evidence that ADP handles state tax registration or account setup for new states, detail on per-state withholding configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-state accuracy.
